name: 面向企业合同管理的 SAP S/4HANA (1XV)
name_en: SAP S/4HANA for Enterprise Contract Management (1XV)
description_en_html:
Overview

connects processes, content, technology, and people in legal departments. It provides a central layer for legal content and an integrated platform for legal technology.

The solution provides the following capabilities:

- End-to-end digitization of legal processes

- Create and manage context for legal transactions

- Create and manage legal transactions

- Easily detect at-risk legal transactions

- Provide extensibility to allow customer to add the fields based on their business needs

Key Process Flow

  • Manage contexts for legal transactions
  • Create or copy legal transactions
  • Maintain respective categories, involved parties, relationships to other legal transactions, workflows, and attach documents

Business Benefits

  • Transform and digitize legal operations
  • Get full traceability of obligations, approvals, signatures, and responsibilities (internal and external)
  • Get smart contracting (anytime, anywhere, device agnostic, automated, paperless)
  • Reduce effort for legal operations such as template and text block provisioning for all business models, all jurisdictions, document drafting, review and approval, task, and obligation tracking
description_zh_html:
概览

将法律部门的流程、内容、技术和人员连接起来。它为法律内容提供了中央层，并为法律技术提供了一个集成平台。

该解决方案提供以下功能：

- 法律流程的端到端数字化

- 创建和管理法律事务的上下文

- 创建和管理法律事务

- 轻松检测有风险的法律事务

- 提供可扩展性，以允许客户根据其业务需求添加字段

关键流程流

  • 管理法律事务的上下文
  • 创建或复制法律事务
  • 维护相应类别、相关方、与其他法律事务的关系、工作流和附加文档

业务优势

  • 革新和数字化法律运营
  • 获得义务、审批、签名和职责的完全可追溯性（内部和外部）
  • 智能签约（随时、随地、设备无关、自动化、无纸化）
  • 减少法律操作的工作量，例如针对所有业务模型、所有司法管辖区的模板和文本块配置、文档起草、审核和审批、任务和义务跟踪
